newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sharp begins mass production of new PC displays.
newsitem.headline: Sharp begins mass production of new PC displays.

text.p: Sharp Corp said on Tuesday that it has begun mass producing and marketing new super twisted nematic (STN) liquid crystal displays (LCDs).
The 12.1-inch LCDs, which can display moving pictures more clearly than existing STN-LCDs, are expected to be used in notebook-size personal computers.
The company plans to manufacture 100,000 displays per month. The displays will be priced at 70,000 yen, the company said in a statement.
